statement: Manufacturing site is Moderna, Inc. — Norwood, MA Facility

subject: mRNA-4157 Drug Substance manufacturing
statement: Manufacturing process consists of six sequential steps: mRNA Synthesis using T7 RNA Polymerase IVT at 36.2°C, mRNA Purification using Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C, LNP Formulation using Microfluidic Mixing at 40 mL/min flow rate, Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C, Sterile Filtration using 0.22 µm filter at ambient temperature, and Fill-Finish with vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 conditions.
